title: Single cell isolation from human skeletal muscle
author: Hongbo Zhang

steps_raw.instruction: Single cell isolation from human skeletal muscle
1. Colleagenase II stock solution

This solution is prepared by dissolving Collagenase II powder in 1X PBS so that the final concentration is 1000 U/ml. Sterilize with 0.22 μm filter and store as 1-ml aliquots at −20°C. Thaw on ice before use. For 230U/mg colleagenase =1000/230 = 4.35 mg/ml
2. Dispase stock solution

This solution is prepared by dissolving Dispase powder in 1X PBS so that the final concentration is 11 U/ml. Sterilize with 0.22 μm filter and store as 1-ml aliquots at −20°C. Thaw and centrifuge at >10,000 rpm for 1 min before use. Avoid taking the pellet after centrifugation for digest. For 1.79U/mg dispase = 11/1.79 = 6.15 mg/ml
3. Muscle dissociation medium

750 U/ml Collagenase II solution prepared in WM. Prepare 15 ml for each human sample. This reagent should be prepared freshly by dissolving Collagenase II powder in PBS before the dissection and kept on ice until needed. Sterilize with 0.22 μm filter if necessary. For 230U/mg colleagenase = 750/230 = 3.26 mg/ml (48.9mg for 15ml)
Mix the percoll sotution 9:1 with 10x PBS (e.g. 4.5ml Percoll + 0.5 ml 10X PBS)
2. forceps and scissors.
3. 100micron cell strainer.
4. 40micron strainer.
Experimental procedure:
1. Prepare 15ml Muscle dissociation media for each human sample. Take the colleagenase and dispase stock solution from -20 and put on ice.
2. Dissect and collect ±2g human intercostal muscle in a 35mm tissue culture dish with ±3ml PBS.
3. Remove the fat from muscle using a scissors, and wash the muscle with 1X PBS twice
4. Mechanically chop the muscle into 1mm pieces with a razor, mix the red and white muscles.

5. weight and divide the muscle for different experiments. Normally we take 0.3g for nuclei isolation, and keep the rest of single cell isoaltaion. The muscle for single cell isolation would be ±2g, ideally.
6. continue to mince the muscle for 2min until you can not see any big muscle piece.
7. digest in the Muscle dissociation medium for 90min in a 37 degrees water bath, shake each 15min
8. 650g centrifugation at 4 degrees for 5min

9. remove the supernatant and suspend the cell in 7.18ml PBS, add 1ml collagenase and 1.82ml dispase stock solution. Mixture the tissue well by pipetting up and down through a 10ml serological pipette.
10. continue to digest 30min in a 37 degrees water bath, shake each 15min.
11. stop the digestion by adding 10ml of 2% FBS in PBS
12. filter the cells through 100 and 40micron strainer successively.
13. Centrifuge at 650g for 3min to pellet the cells.
14. Wash the cells once with 2% FBS in PBS
15. Resuspend the cells in 10ml of 2% FBS, add 2.86ml of Percoll solution to create a 20% Percoll-cell solution.
16. Transfer the solution to a specific high-speed (red cap) 50ml-centrifuge tube. Prepare a balance tube.
17. Centrifuge the cells at 15000g for 20min at 4 degrees, setup the brake at 5 instead of normally used 9.
18. Remove the supernatant and collect the cell layer, or directly collect cells from solution using a 1ml pipette.
19. Wash the cells with 10 times of 2% FBS in PBS
20. The intact cells were stained using trypan blue and quantified by counting with a hemocytometer.
